rationale: The original thesis relied on defending the $23.64 support level and reclaiming the 5-minute 9-EMA ($23.77) for a late-day breakout, but price rejected at $23.80 and is now breaking below $23.64 ($23.63 last) on expanding sell volume (55.4k shares on the latest 1-minute down bar).
